scan_semantics: At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.
safety_priority: Stop and ambiguous button combinations command neutral

formal_properties.explanation: Invalid or stopped requests produce neutral.
Reversal from reverse has one neutral output scan.
Reversal from forward has one neutral output scan.
A permitted forward jog operates immediately.
A permitted reverse jog operates immediately.

atomic_propositions.ForwardButton: Forward jog request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.ReverseButton: Reverse jog request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Stop: Stop request Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Forward: Forward contactor command Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.Reverse: Reverse contactor command Boolean names are propositions; numeric names appear only inside defined predicates.
atomic_propositions.first: True only on the first invocation after resetting the FB instance.
atomic_propositions.qForward: Previous scan Forward output; initially FALSE.
atomic_propositions.qReverse: Previous scan Reverse output; initially FALSE.
